algorithms.load: Official integrated hourly load, source EST/EDT retained; conflicting duplicate/missing keys remain NaN
algorithms.P32_time: No source timezone column; New York calendar plus explicit per-channel raw-order fall clock rewind, fail closed if ambiguous
algorithms.P32_mean: Forward-hold time-weighted mean on [UTC hour, next UTC hour); same-timestamp rows averaged; complete brackets and maximum source gap600s required
algorithms.P32_alternative: Unfilled raw-row arithmetic mean in physical UTC hour, retained only as paper-method diagnostic
algorithms.P32_limit_sentinels: Per-sign flags detect any contributing raw held sample with absolute value9999 before duplicate averaging; mixed sentinel/finite averages are not usable limits
algorithms.missing_policy: No interpolation, extrapolation, long-gap fill, or fabricated spring/fall hour

limitations: SCH channels are schedules, not observed actual interchange; overlapping HQ channels are retained separately and not summed
Published P32 Flow (MWH) numeric values are treated as power in MW consistently with the existing source pipeline; no energy rescaling
P32 EST/EDT is inferred from the calendar and raw clock order, not supplied telemetry
Source quality flags do not establish model accuracy, physical ratings, bus-level demand, or dispatch validity
